contract: Check the universal inequality chain without fitting constants, independently reconstruct complete Hessians, reject corrupted bounds, and distinguish printed constants from corrected existence statements.

acceptance.VERIFIED: Every printed implication and constant has a valid machine-checkable derivation.
acceptance.FALSIFIED: An assumption-satisfying counterexample contradicts a printed quantified conclusion.
acceptance.BLOCKED: A proof gap is located but neither repaired equivalence nor an exact counterexample resolves the printed claim.
